assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All submitted site and key-area polygons are the maintainer-defined provisional rough boundaries (provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false) from provisional_boundaries.geojson; they are concept generation and display aids only.
assumptions.impact: No official area, redline, or approval conclusion is derived; when official polygons arrive the whole package must be recomputed.

assumptions.statement: The land-use grid (LU-001..LU-065) is a design proposal organised around the heritage-park spine and the three cores, expressed with national land-use codes; it is not an approved regulatory land-use plan.
assumptions.impact: Land-use ratios are recomputable design indicators, not statutory conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints (BLDG-001..BLDG-017) are concept design carriers at the three key areas and corridor nodes, not a survey of existing buildings.
assumptions.impact: Footprint area is recomputable for supply estimation; floor area, FAR, height and density remain unknown until official controls and a building survey are available.

assumptions.statement: The proposal contains 13 AI scenario cards (4 industry test-and-validation), 6 user personas and 4 AI pilgrimage landmarks (all concept landmarks, none approved or built).
assumptions.impact: Counts are operational performance metrics, never regulatory-plan indicators.

assumptions.statement: Phasing bands (PHASE-001..003) are concept staging by north-south belt segments; activity, attraction, funding and policy arrangements are concept directions, not settled government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: Phasing is directional and reversible; no implementation commitment is implied.
